chars.N: NARRATOR: a young man of 21 wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans, white sneakers.
chars.D: DAD: an older man wearing a grey djellaba and a white knitted cap.
chars.M: MOM: a middle-aged woman wearing a maroon house kaftan and a beige headscarf.
chars.C: COUSIN: a young woman wearing a sage-green long dress and a cream headscarf, holding a phone with a pink case.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan living room with low sofas and a carpet, seen from the doorway where their son stands: DAD and MOM sit on the sofa and react in shock and disapproval, DAD frowning with arms crossed, MOM with a hand raised in protest, both looking toward the viewer. Head-to-waist framing, faces clearly visible, tense but slightly comic mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room: DAD stands and wags his finger at NARRATOR, who stands awkwardly scratching his head, embarrassed. Both faces visible, medium shot.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In a simple countryside village house courtyard in Morocco with whitewashed walls, olive trees and hills behind: COUSIN sits on a step typing on her pink phone, hopeful hesitant smile. Medium shot, face visible.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on his bed in a small bedroom of a city apartment, evening light, looking down at his phone with a guilty sad face, his free hand on his forehead.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN stands by an open wooden window of the village house at dusk, holding her pink phone to her chest, looking out at the dirt road waiting, wistful face visible.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR lies on his back on his bed at night smiling dreamily at the ceiling, holding his phone on his chest, a warm lamp glow, a small doodle-like heart shape floating above him.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on the rooftop terrace of a city apartment at night with a coastal city skyline behind, on a phone call, nervous shy smile, one hand rubbing the back of his neck.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: COUSIN sits on a mattress in a modest village room at night, talking on her pink phone, looking down shyly and smiling, one hand covering half her smile, face visible.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR in his bedroom happily packing a backpack for a trip, sunny summer light through the window, excited big smile.
